page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Ax.Flex.16-64 is a flexible compute instance powered by the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor family on the 64-bit ARM (arm64) architecture. The instance is configured with 32 dedicated physical cores running 32 vCPUs at a single thread per core, avoiding performance interference associated with simultaneous multithreading. It features 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include hardware accelerators such as GPUs and does not come provisioned with integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for non-volatile persistent storage. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. The dedicated core architecture ensures consistent execution environments without hyper-threading contention, although workloads reliant on x86-specific instruction sets or specialized hardware acceleration are not supported.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the configuration is oriented toward compute-dense workloads rather than memory-heavy database configurations. The hardware profile is well suited for highly parallel ARM-native operations, including continuous integration build pipelines, containerized microservices, scientific compute jobs, web server farms, and general batch compute processing.
